metaTitle: Land Rover Engine Rebuild Process | Land Rover Garage
metaDescription: Our 10-step engine rebuild process for Land Rover models - from arrival and strip-down to machining, reassembly, testing, and handover. Every rebuild follows the same workshop-proven procedure.
lede: Our workshop-proven 10-step process - from arrival and strip-down to machining, reassembly, testing, and handover.

sections.heading: What the Engine Rebuild Process Involves

blocks.html: A full engine rebuild means dismantling the engine to its bare components, inspecting every part, machining the block and crankshaft where needed, replacing all wear-and-tear items, and reassembling to factory specification. Every engine that arrives in our workshop follows the same 10-step procedure - regardless of whether it's a classic 200Tdi Defender, a TDV6 Discovery, or a modern Ingenium-powered Range Rover.

The process is carried out in-house, using Land Rover-specific tools and diagnostic systems. We don't outsource machining or assembly - every stage is completed on the premises, with quality checks at every step.

steps.title: Vehicle Arrival & Assessment
steps.body: Vehicle arrives at the workshop (often via recovery). We carry out an initial inspection and diagnostic scan, then consult with the customer and provide a quotation.

steps.title: Engine Removal
steps.body: Vehicle is placed on a lift, fluids are drained, and all connections are disconnected. The engine is then lifted out safely using specialist equipment.

steps.title: Strip-Down & Inspection
steps.body: Engine is mounted on a stand and stripped down completely. Every component is inspected for wear, damage, or out-of-specification conditions.

steps.title: Component Assessment & Quoting
steps.body: Components are assessed for reusability. The customer is updated on findings, a final quotation is prepared, and authorisation is obtained before work continues.

steps.title: Machining
steps.body: Cylinder block is bored and honed, crankshaft is ground and polished, cylinder heads are resurfaced and pressure-tested. All components are brought back to specification.

steps.title: Parts Sourcing
steps.body: All required parts are identified and OEM-quality components are sourced. Parts inventory is checked to ensure everything is on hand before reassembly begins.

steps.title: Engine Reassembly
steps.body: New bearings, pistons, and rings are fitted. New timing components, seals, and gaskets are installed throughout. All components are torqued to factory specification.

steps.title: Reinstallation & Reconnection
steps.body: The rebuilt engine is lifted back into the vehicle, all connections are remade, and fluids are refilled to the correct levels.

steps.title: Testing & Calibration
steps.body: Engine is started and run to operating temperature. Diagnostic scans and calibrations are performed, and leak checks are carried out.

steps.title: Road Test & Handover
steps.body: Full road test is conducted, followed by a final quality check. The vehicle is valeted and handed over to the customer with full documentation.

items: **In-house machining and assembly** - every stage completed on our premises, not outsourced.
**Land Rover specialist tooling & diagnostics** - JLR SDD, Pathfinder, and TOPix used throughout.
**12-month unlimited-mileage warranty** - standard on every rebuild.
**Transparent fixed-price quoting** - no hidden fees, quoted after strip-down inspection.
**Full rebuild documentation** - detailed records of every component replaced and every specification checked.

sections.heading: How the Rebuild Process Works for You

steps.title: Contact us for a quote
steps.body: Call, WhatsApp, or use our [online quote form](/get-quote). We'll ask for your registration and vehicle details to match the correct engine family.

steps.title: Arrival & inspection
steps.body: Vehicle arrives at our workshop (we can arrange recovery). We carry out a full inspection, strip-down, and provide a fixed-price quote before work begins.

steps.title: Rebuild & test
steps.body: We complete the rebuild, testing, and road test. You're kept updated throughout. Collection or delivery arranged when the vehicle is ready.

items.q: How long does a Land Rover engine rebuild take?
items.a: Most Land Rover engine rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from arrival at our workshop, depending on engine type and parts availability. We keep you updated throughout the process.

items.q: What's included in a full engine rebuild?
items.a: A full rebuild includes strip-down, inspection, machining of the cylinder block and crankshaft, cylinder head resurfacing and pressure-testing, new bearings, pistons, rings, timing components, seals, and gaskets throughout, reassembly to specification, reinstallation, fluids, testing, calibration, and road testing.

items.q: Do you offer a warranty on engine rebuilds?
items.a: Yes, every engine rebuild we carry out is covered by a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty. [Full warranty terms here →](/warranty)

items.q: Do you rebuild all Land Rover engine types?
items.a: Yes, our workshop rebuilds all Land Rover engine families including the AJ133 V8 supercharged, Ingenium diesel and petrol four- and six-cylinder units, TDV6/SDV6, TDV8/SDV8, Td5, 200Tdi, 300Tdi, Ford EcoBoost, and Duratorq engines fitted to Land Rover models.

items.q: Can I get a quote before committing to a rebuild?
items.a: Yes, we provide a fixed-price quote after our initial inspection and strip-down assessment. We update you on findings and agree on the scope of work before proceeding with the rebuild. [Request a quote →](/get-quote)
